items.title: Multiple Splunk Enterprise Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Execute Unauthorized JavaScript code
items.description: Splunk has released patches for multiple vulnerabilities in its Enterprise and Cloud Platform products, some of which could allow attackers to execute unauthorized JavaScript code, access sensitive information, or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. The advisories, published on October 1, 2025, detail six security flaws, with severity ratings ranging from Medium to High. The most […] The…
